messages:
sara: Noticed ~48 invoices flagged with line item 'UNKNOWN SKU' in NetSuite after last night's sync. All from the same integration batch. Anyone else seeing this?

jess: I saw a couple, thought it was a bad mapping for custom SKUs. Can you paste an example invoice id?

sara: inv_4Lmn... sample payload shows stripe line description: 'enterprise-usage-2026-03-22-experiment:cohort_B-verylongsuffix' but NetSuite lookup got only 'enterprise-usage-2026-03-22-experiment:cohort_B-veryl' (truncated).

ops: Checking proxy logs now. There is a proxy sanitization rule that trims headers/payload fields >128 bytes. This might be hitting the line description.

tom: If the SKU suffix includes the cohort tag we use for pricing overrides, truncation will break our item lookup and fallback to UNKNOWN SKU. That will create an invoice but with the misapplied item mapping.

jess: Can you post the raw vs received snippet?

sara: Raw payload excerpt:
```
{"id":"inv_4Lmn...","lines":[{"id":"li_1","description":"enterprise-usage-2026-03-22-experiment:cohort_B-verylongsuffix-₀"}]}
```
Received at mapping service:
```
{"invoice_id":"inv_4Lmn...","lines":[{"description":"enterprise-usage-2026-03-22-experiment:cohort_B-veryl"}]}
```

ops: Confirmed in logs: proxy-truncation rule fired 48 times between 03:10-03:12 UTC. Entry: `proxy.sanitize.trim_field(description) reason=max_field_len`

finance-lead: If NetSuite has unknown items on invoices we can't close month-end properly. What's the blast radius? Dollars?

sara: Preliminary: $12.4k across 48 invoices. Mostly small amounts, some high-usage accounts.

tom: Root cause hypothesis: earlier change to proxy introduced a generic truncation to protect against giant payloads but didn't whitelist Stripe line descriptions. We rely on the last 20-30 chars for cohort tag.

jess: Mitigation options:
- Quick revert proxy sanitize change (hotfix) to restore original behavior.
- Patch mapping service to fall back to fuzzy match on partial description for cohorts (safer short-term).
- Backfill NetSuite items by running a script that matches truncated descriptions to full list and updates lines. Requires finance approval + audit trace.

billing-bot: ACTION_CREATED by sara: #backfill_ticket FIN-5321 assigned to tom, due 2026-03-24

ops: I've rolled back the sanitize rule on the proxy and restarted the consumer. Will monitor for new truncations.

tom: I'll build a fuzzy match script that uses Levenshtein + cohort tag regex to map the 48 affected lines to correct item ids. Will produce a dry-run CSV with: invoice_id, line_id, received_desc, matched_item, confidence_score.

finance-lead: We need a dry-run output and an audit plan before any NetSuite writes. Also require a test run on sandbox NS.

jess: Good. Also adding a unit test to the proxy suite to assert that "description" fields up to 512 bytes are preserved for Stripe payloads.

ops: Note: there were two webhook replays at 03:11 which may have produced duplicates; I disabled auto-replay until we confirm mapping fix.

tom: ETA for dry-run CSV 90m. Will include checks to avoid double-updating lines where invoice status moved to 'paid' after creation.

sara: Customer comms: if you get a ticket about odd invoice line items, tell them we are reconciling and expect corrected invoice/credit within 48 hours.

finance-lead: Approved for sandbox dry-run and manual production backfill pending dry-run results. Provide rollback steps and ledger trace for audit.

billing-bot: NOTE: backfill_ticket FIN-5321 status=OPEN created_by=sara

ops: Monitoring shows no new UNKNOWN SKU after rollback. Will watch for an hour then re-enable auto-replay.

tom: Posting dry-run artifacts to shared drive and will ping when ready.
